name: YearWith
core_function_original: YearWith gives every customer of an online store their own year-in-review: their orders, favourite product, how long they've been a customer, and a thank-you offer. Works with orders exports from Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Razorpay or any spreadsheet. Everything is computed in your browser, so your customer list never leaves your laptop. Send it from Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Shopify Email or WhatsApp. One-time pricing from $149, taxes included.
